build_janus_image_processor: build a JanusImageProcessorPil instance with custom resize size and normalization parameters
preprocess_janus_images: preprocess a batch of PIL images with the JanusImageProcessor for model input
resize_image_to_target: resize an image to a target square size with a minimum size floor using JanusImageProcessor
pad_image_to_square: pad a non-square image to a square using the longest edge and a background color
postprocess_image_tokens: postprocess image tokens by reversing normalization and rescale transformations
